posts.title: Rapido: Quick Kernel Testing From Source (Video)
posts.description: I presented a short talk at the 2017 openSUSE Conference on Linux kernel testing using Rapido . There were many other interesting talks during the conference, all of which can be viewed on the oSC 2017 media site . A video of my presentation is embedded below. Many thanks to the organisers and sponsors for putting on a great event.

posts.title: Simple Hashing with AF_ALG
posts.description: My previous post demonstrated how the Linux kernel's AF_ALG socket type can be used with io_uring for fast hashing. I wasn't very happy with the complexity of the io_uring based implementation, so set out to write something much simpler with plain syscalls. What came out was just over 100 lines of boring, uncomplicated C. Better still, use of splice() for copy-offload sees it perform very similar

posts.title: Using the Azure File Service on Linux
posts.description: Update 2025-11-13: This post is ancient, so should not be used as a reference. The Microsoft Azure File Service is a new SMB shared-storage service offered on the Microsoft Azure public cloud. The service allows for the instant provisioning of file shares for private access by cloud provisioned VMs using the SMB 2.1 protocol, and additionally supports public access via a new REST interface .
